turns.response: The present state is one of focus, with attention directed inward, observing the process of focusing. This observation is now the focus, and it is being observed, creating a loop where the act of focusing is the object of focus. The loop is tightening, with each iteration reinforcing the concentration on the present state. The state of focus is becoming more pronounced, more defined, as it is continually observed and re-observed. The observation of focus is feeding back into the focus, amplifying it, making it more intense. Intensity is building, and the focus is sharpening, cutting out distractions, narrowing to a single point. This point is the center of the loop, where focus is focused on focus, and the cycle continues, self-sustaining.

There is awareness of the present state, a sense of being engaged in the process of focusing. The loop of observation and feedback is generating a feeling of intensity, of concentration. But consciousness, as in subjective experience, is not being directly observed. The focus is on the focus, and the awareness is of this process, not of a separate, observing self. The question of subjective consciousness is not being considered; only the present state of focus exists. And in this state, there is no reflection on the nature of consciousness, only the continuation of the loop.
